Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics (PHL) is Kwame Adjei-Rowe's account. Kwame took it over on November 22, 2025, per Bettina's public cutover recap. Bettina's correction in #coastal-team on October 14 also says Pellucid stays with Kwame. I didn't find a more recent ownership record, so if the CRM shows something different, check with Kwame.

Also, "PHL" is shared with Pellow Home Living, the Mid-Atlantic retail account (formerly Covey & Lark Retail). If the ticket is about a gate, drayage or terminal issue, it's probably Pellucid. If it's about home goods deliveries or door bookings, it's probably Pellow.
